preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard n must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain exactly n integers, each from 1 to n, with no duplicates.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not solution else True
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output the regions.

postconditions.expression: all(len(region) == i for i, region in enumerate(solution, start=1))
postconditions.description: Each region must contain exactly i cells, where i is the region number.

postconditions.expression: all(region[j] == p[i] for i, region in enumerate(solution, start=1) for j in range(i))
postconditions.description: Each region must contain the number written on the main diagonal cell (i, i) at position i.
